This compound, in turn, is predicted to interact with the CD276 antigen. The scores indicate a moderate level of confidence in this pathway, suggesting that Prejadomycin may modulate the expression or function of CD276 antigen through the HaCaT cells. The evidence is consistent with a mechanistic link, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction and functional role of Prejadomycin in regulating CD276 antigen. The pathway is supported by a coherent sequence of interactions, but the strength of the evidence remains moderate, and the role of intermediate compounds like (1R,4R)-4-Hydroxydauca-7-Ene-6,9-Dione needs to be investigated.
